# NFL Daily — 2026-09-08 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Patriots CB Christian Gonzalez agreed to a four-year, $135M extension with $102M guaranteed, making him the NFL's highest-paid cornerback. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49865736/sources-christian-gonzalez-patriots-reach-4-year-135m-deal)
- Rams DT Aaron Donald will not travel to Australia and is ruled out for Thursday's opener vs. the 49ers; his next chance to play is Week 3 vs. the Giants. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49871629/rams-aaron-donald-travel-australia-week-1)
- Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes is expected to start Monday's opener vs. the Broncos, nine months removed from tearing his ACL and LCL. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49870606/patrick-mahomes-expected-start-chiefs-opener-vs-broncos-mnf)
- Eagles DE Brandon Graham announced his retirement for a second time, closing a 16-year career spent entirely with Philadelphia and two Super Bowl rings. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49870106/eagles-brandon-graham-announces-retires-nfl-2nd)
- The NFL's 2026 rule changes take effect this week, including a new "3-strike" suspension system for repeated personal fouls and adjustments to kickoffs. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7563064/2026/09/08/nfl-2026-rule-changes-kickoffs-three-strike/)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Ravens DT Nnamdi Madubuike is questionable ahead of Week 1. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Browns QB Dillon Gabriel is on injured reserve. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Bengals WR Tee Higgins is questionable ahead of the season opener. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Bills WR Keon Coleman (foot) is questionable but listed as a starter on Buffalo's Week 1 depth chart. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Bills OT Jedrick Wills Jr. is questionable ahead of Sunday's opener. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Bears WR Rome Odunze (leg) is day-to-day and questionable for Sunday's opener. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
